## Accepted partial results; general problem unresolved

Target: 3000061 / AMR-029-0061. The complete authored report and independent
mathematical audit establish exact articulation decomposition; an undirected
lower bound and sound cycle-chain optimum certificate; a deterministic exact
polynomial algorithm with at most one fixed arc per relevant block; the cactus
specialization; a three-state exact algorithm for a valid supplied two-terminal
series-parallel expression; a four-vertex repeated-edge obstruction with
unbounded gap and zero-weight equality limitation; and per-orientation,
value-preserving equivalence with arbitrary mixed two-pair min-sum orientation.

The explicit finite mixed-multigraph model retains nonnegative binary-rational
lengths including zero, parallel edge identities, immutable fixed arcs,
shared same-direction edges, equal terminals, nonnegative loops and infinite
distances. No global strong-connectivity requirement is added. The SP claim
requires its valid supplied decomposition and is not an arbitrary-terminal
recognition claim. A failed cycle-chain certificate means unknown.

General mixed blocks and their orientation dependencies remain unresolved.
No general deterministic exact polynomial algorithm, target hardness theorem,
novelty, priority, or current-worldwide-open certificate is claimed.

## Distribution and review limits

Exactly eight authored report/audit/acceptance/status and public-source review
or metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/3000061/`.
All analytic arguments, recovery procedures, bit-complexity bounds, edge cases
and residual qualifications are preserved. Editorial changes make the public
file identities, completed partial acceptance, recorded supplementary evidence
and source-inspection chronology explicit. No mathematical correction was
required. Full analytic proofs depend on no omitted executable.

This AI-assisted manuscript is unrefereed. Acceptance means the accompanying
scoped mathematical audit, not external human peer review, journal acceptance
or formal proof-assistant certification. Finite checks are historical aggregate
supporting metadata only. Programs, raw generated outputs, datasets, copied
third-party source bodies/PDFs/images and private coordination material are
excluded. Edition preparation performed no new scholarly-source retrieval,
source-file rehash, source inspection, literature search or mathematical test
rerun. Public literature citations retain their exact model limitations.

Original problem:
https://oldlemon.cs.elte.hu/egres/open/Orientation_with_shortest_round_trip

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. This is editorial preparation
of the accepted first attempt: no extra substantive proof response or accounting
reset. No merge, release, DOI, journal submission or outside outreach is requested.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
